newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China rice winery mulls 35 mln A share issue.
newsitem.headline: China rice winery mulls 35 mln A share issue.

text.p: Zhejiang Guyue Longshan Shaoxing Wine Co Ltd is planning an initial public offering of 35 million A shares for listing in Shanghai, a company spokesman said on Tuesday.

The company, based in Shaoxing city in eastern Zhejiang province, would apply to China Securities Regulatory Commission by the end of this month, the spokesman told China Securities Bulletin, a Hong Kong-based newsletter.
CITIC Securities Co Ltd had been appointed chief underwriter, he said.
Guyue would use share proceeds to boost production of its rice wine, the official said.
Guyue, which makes about 60,000 tonnes of rice wine a year, exported about 10,000 tonnes a year to Japan and Southeast Asia, the official said.

The firm forecast pre-tax profits of 90 million yuan for 1997, compared with 53 million yuan in 1996 and 32.50 million yuan in 1995, he said, adding that his expectation of a surge in this year's profits was based on efforts to boost sales and cut costs.
